title: Bug: slugify() leaves punctuation in output and does not collapse consecutive separators
body:
## Bug Report
**File:** `src/slugify.py`

`slugify('Hello, World!')` returns `'hello,-world!'` — only whitespace/underscores are split, so punctuation survives and consecutive separators produce repeated hyphens ('a  b' -> 'a--b').
### Expected
- lowercase, non-alphanumerics become single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens
- `slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'`
